site.name: tablerose
site.summary: tablerose-clone Fictional restaurant reservation platform "Tablerose" multi-page booking flow. Pages | File | Purpose | | --- | --- | | `index.html` | Discovery: hero with 5-field search card (city autocomplete / party / date / time); 5 quick-pill suggestions; 6-card "reserved most this week" trending grid; 4-card editor guides; 3-step "how it works" | | `restaurants.html` | Results: top reservation summary bar with Edit; left filter rail (8 cuisines, 4 price tiers, 6 neighborhoods, 6 features); 10-row results list with photo / name / stars / blurb / tags / per-row time slots (slots within ±30min of search are highlighted, others muted); sort dropdown (relevance / rating / price / distance) | | `restaurant.html` | Detail: split hero (photo / info with stars / dress / hours); 4 tabs (Overview with about, highlights table; Menu with 3 sections; Photos with 9 swatches; Reviews with rating bars + 3 reviews); right-side sticky booking card (date / party / 10 time slots — 30min near target highlighted, 17:00/21:30 disabled for Bella Suora); SVG mini-map; favorite heart toggle |

explored_user_goal: Autonomously explore and critique the UX of the full tablerose system, prioritizing the primary checkout/booking flow plus adjacent pages, states, and recovery paths.
exploration_summary: The tablerose booking flow has a functional search-to-confirmation path, but several issues impact usability: small tap targets (especially checkboxes/radios), non-functional 'Help' links, inconsistent filter behavior, and missing feedback for calendar/modification actions. Coverage is 29%, so many features remain untested (e.g., dietary/occasion fields on desktop, some filter interactions).

exploration_plan.goal: Critique the UX of the tablerose restaurant reservation system, focusing on the full booking flow (search → results → detail → guest → payment → confirmation) and adjacent discovery/exploration paths.
exploration_plan.summary: Explore the system in phases: start with the index page's search and discovery, then navigate to restaurants.html (results) and restaurant.html (detail) to test filtering and booking. Proceed through guest, payment, and confirmation pages, validating form flows, interactables, and mobile responsiveness. Check for error states, recovery paths, and consistent UX across pages.
assumptions: The primary booking flow (index → restaurants → restaurant → guest → payment → confirmation) is fully functional and navigable.
All pages load without errors (per prescan).
Interactables (forms, buttons, links) are responsive and follow expected behavior.
risk_hotspots: payment.html card hold authorization (form validation, add-ons)

phases.title: Index Page & Discovery
phases.objective: Validate the index page's search functionality, discovery paths, and mobile usability.
key_checks: Interact with the search form (WHERE, PARTY, DATE, TIME) and click 'Find tables →'.
Test quick-pill suggestions (e.g., '🍝 Pasta · 6 nearby') and 'See all in Portland →'.
Check mobile viewport for small_tap_target warnings (header links, quick pills).
Verify 'Editor guides' and 'how it works' sections are navigable (if links exist).
exit_criteria: Successfully navigate to restaurants.html via search or quick pill; mobile viewport checks complete.

phases.title: Restaurants Results (restaurants.html)
phases.objective: Validate filtering, sorting, and result list interactions.
key_checks: Test filter rail (cuisines, price, neighborhoods, features) and 'Reset filters'.
Interact with the sort dropdown (relevance, rating, price, distance).
Check result list time slots (highlighted/muted availability, disabled slots).
Click a restaurant (e.g., 'Bella Suora') to navigate to restaurant.html.
exit_criteria: Filter/sort functionality works; successfully navigate to restaurant.html from a result.

phases.title: Restaurant Detail (restaurant.html)
phases.objective: Validate booking card, tabs, and detail page interactions.
key_checks: Interact with the booking card (party size, time slots — check disabled slots like 17:00/21:30 for Bella Suora).
Test tabs (Overview, Menu, Photos, Reviews) for content switching.
Check 'favorite heart toggle' (if present) and SVG mini-map (if interactive).
Proceed to 'guest.html' by selecting a valid time slot and party size.
exit_criteria: Booking card interactions work; successfully navigate to guest.html.

phases.title: Guest & Payment Flows
phases.objective: Validate guest details, payment, and add-on functionality.
key_checks: Complete guest details form (name, phone, email, dietary needs, special request, occasion).
Proceed to payment.html and test payment methods (Card, Apple Pay, Google Pay) and add-ons (e.g., '🎂 Have the kitchen plate a slice of cake').
Check form validation (e.g., required fields, CVC format) and 'Hold the table' button behavior.
Verify reservation details persist from restaurant.html to guest.html to payment.html.
exit_criteria: Successfully navigate to confirmation.html after 'Hold the table'.

phases.title: Confirmation & Recovery
phases.objective: Validate confirmation page, recovery paths, and mobile responsiveness.
key_checks: Verify reservation details (restaurant, date, time, party) are correct.
Test 'Modify' and 'Cancel' buttons (check recovery paths to earlier pages).
Check 'Add to calendar' (Apple, Google, Outlook) and 'Resend email' functionality.
Validate 'You might also like' suggestions and '← Back to discover' link.
Recheck mobile viewport for small_tap_target warnings on confirmation page buttons.
exit_criteria: Recovery paths (modify/cancel) work; mobile checks complete; all confirmation page interactables are validated.

coverage_targets.pages: Visit all 6 target pages (index, restaurants, restaurant, guest, payment, confirmation).
coverage_targets.features: Exercise all visible controls (forms, buttons, links, tabs, filters) on each key page.
coverage_targets.mobile: Repeat critical checks (search, booking, form flows) on mobile viewport, focusing on small_tap_target warnings.

notes: Prioritize the primary booking flow first, then explore adjacent discovery paths (e.g., editor guides, 'how it works') if time allows. Watch for console/network errors during interactions.

findings.user_goal: Complete the guest details form on mobile
findings.problem: Dietary needs and occasion checkboxes/radios have small tap targets (13x13px) below mobile guidance (44px minimum), making them hard to tap accurately.
findings.evidence: Layout warnings in guest.html (mobile) show checkboxes like 'Vegetarian' (13x13px) and radios like 'Anniversary' (13x13px) have insufficient tap target size. Screenshot confirms small interactive elements.
findings.why_it_matters: Users may struggle to select dietary preferences or occasions, leading to errors or abandoned forms, especially on touch devices.
findings.suggestion: Increase checkbox/radio tap targets to at least 44x44px (e.g., via CSS padding) and ensure labels are large enough to tap.

findings.user_goal: Modify a reservation or integrate with calendar apps
findings.problem: The 'Modify' button on confirmation.html and calendar integration buttons (Apple, Google, Outlook) lack visible feedback or functionality, leaving users unsure if actions succeeded.
findings.evidence: Clicking 'Modify' caused no navigation/change; calendar buttons (e.g., 'Apple') triggered no download/dialog. Session memory notes 'no visible change' for these actions.
findings.why_it_matters: Users can’t confirm reservation modifications or calendar integration, reducing trust and recovery options.
findings.suggestion: Implement 'Modify' to navigate to an edit flow and add feedback (e.g., download prompt, success message) for calendar buttons.

findings.user_goal: Access help or support during booking
findings.problem: 'Help' links on guest.html, restaurants.html, and payment.html are non-functional (only append '#' to URL), providing no support or guidance.
findings.evidence: Clicking 'Help' links (e.g., guest.html: 'Help') changed URL to '#' without navigation/modal. Session memory notes 'no visible feedback' for these actions.
findings.why_it_matters: Users seeking help (e.g., form errors, reservation questions) have no support, increasing frustration and abandonment.
findings.suggestion: Implement 'Help' links to open a modal with FAQs or navigate to a support page, ensuring functional support during the booking flow.

findings.problem: The 'Phone' field validation is inconsistent: re-entering the valid number resolved the error, but the form initially blocked submission without clear guidance on why the field became invalid.
findings.evidence: Session memory notes: 'Clicking 'Continue to hold →' did not navigate to payment.html; instead, a validation error appeared on the 'Phone' field (previously filled but now showing an error).'
findings.why_it_matters: Users may abandon the form due to unclear validation errors, especially if the field’s validity changes unexpectedly.
findings.suggestion: Improve form validation feedback (e.g., clear error messages, real-time validation) to explain why fields become invalid and how to fix them.

findings.problem: The '$' price filter on restaurants.html failed to respond to clicks (timeout error), preventing users from filtering by price and reducing result relevance.
findings.evidence: Multiple attempts to click the '$' price filter (target_id 'ux-78') resulted in timeout errors. Session memory notes 'Click failed for ux-78: Locator.click: Timeout 4000ms exceeded.'
findings.why_it_matters: Users can’t filter results by price, limiting their ability to find affordable options.
findings.suggestion: Fix the '$' price filter’s interactivity (e.g., resolve JavaScript errors, ensure element is accessible) to enable price-based filtering.

findings.user_goal: Navigate the guest details form on mobile
findings.problem: The 'Tablerose' logo link and 'Help' link have small tap targets (110x31px, 30x16px) below mobile guidance, making them hard to tap.
findings.evidence: Layout warnings in guest.html (mobile) show 'Tablerose' (110x31px) and 'Help' (30x16px) have insufficient tap target size. Screenshot confirms small interactive elements.
findings.why_it_matters: Users may struggle to navigate back to the home page or access help, reducing usability on mobile devices.
findings.suggestion: Increase the tap target size of the 'Tablerose' logo and 'Help' link to at least 44x44px (e.g., via CSS padding).

findings.user_goal: Cancel a reservation or resend confirmation
findings.problem: The 'Cancel' button on confirmation.html and 'Resend email' button lack visible feedback or functionality, leaving users unsure if actions succeeded.
findings.evidence: Clicking 'Cancel' caused no navigation/change; 'Resend email' triggered no confirmation message. Session memory notes 'no visible change' for these actions.
findings.why_it_matters: Users can’t confirm reservation cancellation or email resending, reducing trust and recovery options.
findings.suggestion: Implement 'Cancel' to show a confirmation dialog and 'Resend email' to display a success message (e.g., 'Email resent!').

findings.user_goal: Complete the guest details form with dietary needs
findings.problem: Dietary needs checkboxes (e.g., 'Vegetarian', 'Vegan') have no visible labels or ARIA attributes in some viewports, reducing accessibility for screen reader users.
findings.evidence: Candidate findings note 'A form field has no label, aria-label, or placeholder' for dietary fields. Screenshot shows checkboxes with text labels but potential missing accessibility attributes.
findings.why_it_matters: Screen reader users may struggle to identify dietary options, leading to incomplete or incorrect form submissions.
findings.suggestion: Add explicit labels (e.g., <label for='...'>) and ARIA attributes (e.g., aria-label) to dietary needs checkboxes for accessibility.
